events.title: Andy Waggoner & Friends
events.description: As a soloist and pianist, Andy has performed at The Sheldon Concert Hall, Jazz at the Bistro, and the Kranzberg Arts Center, and served as tenor soloist with the St. Louis Symphony Orchestra for the 2003 Holiday Pops Concerts.

venue.description:
This world-renowned concert hall, known for its perfect acoustics, treats audiences to a wide range of musical performances, while the Sheldon Art Galleries offers 7,000 square feet of gallery space celebrating architecture, photography, music and sound, children’s art and so much more.

Gallery, Event Space, Live Music

events.title: Dvořák’s Eighth
events.description: Inspired by the rolling hills, bird calls, and peaceful charm of the Bohemian countryside, Dvořák weaves together an array of vibrant folk songs and wistful pastoral melodies in his beloved Eighth Symphony. Kaija Saariaho’s ethereal Lumière et Pesanteur adds to the ambience in this dazzling program led by Portuguese conductor Dinis Sousa in his SLSO debut. MacArthur Genius Fellowship awardee and Avery Fisher Prize recipient Jeremy Denk takes on Bartók’s fiery Piano Concerto No. 2, delivering inimitable expressive power.

venue.venue: Saint Louis Symphony Orchestra at Powell Hall
venue.description: Founded in 1880, the St. Louis Symphony Orchestra is the second oldest in the United States and is recognized internationally as an ensemble of the highest caliber, performing a broad musical repertoire.

events.title: The Glass Menagerie
events.description: A faded remnant of Southern gentility, Amanda Wingfield lives in poverty with her children, Tom and Laura. Desperate to secure their future, she pressures shy, fragile Laura to find a suitor. When Tom brings Jim to dinner, hope and heartbreak intertwine. Memory, illusion, and longing blur as each character reaches for a better life. The Glass Menagerie is a luminous, deeply moving classic of the American stage.

events.title: The 25th Annual Putnam County Spelling Bee
events.description: An eclectic group of six mid-pubescents vie for the spelling championship of a lifetime. While candidly disclosing hilarious and touching stories from their home lives, the tweens spell their way through a series of (potentially made-up) words, hoping never to hear the soul-crushing, pout-inducing, life un-affirming “ding” of the bell that signals a spelling mistake. Six spellers enter; one speller leaves a champion!
